# 1. Đứng yên — bảng 4 mặt + đứng yên 3 hướng trong một ảnh (144 lính)

> Sinh tự động bởi `docs/art/prompts/gen_prompts.py` (dữ liệu lấy thẳng từ `packages/core`). Sửa ở script rồi chạy lại
> `python3 docs/art/prompts/gen_prompts.py`, đừng sửa tay file này.

- Ảnh lưu theo hệ ở `docs/art/topdown/<hệ>/` (tên ghi cạnh từng prompt), cạnh `rigs.json` của hệ đó.
- Mỗi kiểu chuyển động **một ảnh 3 hàng** (hàng 1 ngang quay **trái**, hàng 2 trước, hàng 3 sau): `<lính>-idle.png`,
  `<lính>-walk.png`, `<lính>-run.png`, `<lính>-attack.png`, `<lính>-skill.png`.
- Luôn **đính kèm bảng 4 mặt** (`<lính>-views.png`, tạo ở file 1) của chính lính đó để giữ đúng màu, tóc, đồ, cỡ pixel.
- `build_topdown_sprite.py` tự nhận ảnh 3 hàng `<lính>-<kiểu>.png` và các ảnh `<lính>-<kiểu>-side|front|back.png` có đủ 3
  hướng thành `anim.<kiểu>`. Nhìn ngang AI lỡ vẽ quay phải thì khai `"flip": ["left"]` cho kiểu đó trong `rigs.json`.
- Xem trước khi dùng: đủ khung, các khung không chạm nhau, cùng cỡ, chân cùng một vạch đất, **mọi khung cùng một hướng**,
  nền trong suốt thật (không phải ô caro vẽ giả). Sai thì tạo lại, đừng cố cứu.

Mỗi lính 2 prompt:

1. **Bảng 4 mặt** (trên, ngang quay trái, trước, sau), 1 hàng × 4 ô, lưu `<lính>-views.png`. Không cần đính kèm gì;
   đây là mẫu gốc, mọi prompt khác đính kèm ảnh này. Tạo xong mới làm các prompt sau.
2. **Đứng yên 3 hướng** trong **một ảnh** 3 hàng × 6 khung (hàng 1 ngang quay trái, hàng 2 trước, hàng 3 sau), lưu
   `<lính>-idle.png` → `anim.idle`. Nhịp thở rõ (vai, ngực lên xuống), vũ khí nhích 1 px theo nhịp thở (không giơ,
   không vung), áo / khăn bay theo cơn gió nhẹ rồi **chậm dần** lặng xuống.

|---|---|---|

| 5. ⚡ Lôi Kiếm Các — Thunder Blade Hall (hệ Lôi) | 49–60 | [thunder](#5-thunder) |
| 6. 🩸 Huyết Nguyệt Giáo — Blood Moon Cult (hệ Huyết) | 61–72 | [blood](#6-blood) |

## 1. ☀️ Thánh Quang Điện — Temple of Light (hệ Quang)

**1. Thợ mỏ** (×0.9)

*Bảng 4 mặt* → lưu thành `docs/art/topdown/light/miner-views.png` (1 hàng × 4 ô)

```
Pixel art character model sheet: ONE image, ONE row of 4 equal cells, evenly spaced, nothing touching another cell: cell 1 TOP view (seen from straight above, face side pointing DOWN), cell 2 SIDE view facing LEFT, cell 3 FRONT view, cell 4 BACK view. Same character, same size, same standing pose in all 4 cells, the feet of cells 2-4 on one ground line.

VIEWS
- SIDE (cell 2): strict profile facing LEFT, only ONE eye at the left edge of the head.
- FRONT (cell 3): facing the viewer straight on, both eyes, left-right symmetrical apart from the held gear.
- BACK (cell 4): the back to the viewer, no face, the cloth covering the back.

CHARACTER (Temple of Light civilization, Light element, gold miner "Miner"), identical in all 4 cells: same colours, gear, size and pixel scale
- Build: chibi stickman with a big round head (about a third of the total height) and a short body, slightly smaller and leaner, about 90% of a normal stickman. Size: about 18 x 18 px footprint, about 32 px tall.
- Head: big spiky glowing golden hair with a bright white four-pointed star in it, bold pixel clusters hugging the head. Black face, no mouth, no nose; slanted glowing golden eyes (2-pixel clusters with a white core pixel): TWO eyes in the front view, only ONE eye at the front edge of the head in the side view, no eyes in the back and top views.
- Body: solid black body with thin glowing golden crack lines on the limbs, a small brown cloth gold sack with a golden drawstring on a strap at the hip, gold nuggets peeking out.
- Cloth: short scarf in rich gold (#e8a91c), ragged stepped pixel edges, hanging close to the body.
- Gear: glowing pickaxe; every glowing part in radiant gold (#ffd84a).
- Pose: tool resting on the shoulder in one hand, relaxed.

GEAR LOCK (check every one of the 4 cells)
- Always drawn, complete, same size and same colours in EVERY cell: glowing pickaxe; a small brown cloth gold sack with a golden drawstring on a strap at the hip.
- The weapon / tool stays in the same hand; when the body hides part of it, the visible ends still show. A cell without the weapon or tool is wrong.

STYLE
- Chunky pixel art: every art pixel a crisp square block, upscaled with nearest neighbour.
- 3-tone shading (cool dark shadow, saturated mid-tone, warm highlight), bold 1px dark outline.
- Arms, legs, weapon shafts and staffs at least 2 px thick.
- Glows are solid bright pixel clusters with a white-hot core; every effect is a solid pixel shape touching the body, the weapon or the ground line, nothing floating.
- Strictly orthographic: no perspective, no 3/4 angle.
- Background: fully transparent PNG (alpha). No white, no colour, no checkerboard pattern.

AVOID: text, labels, numbers, grid lines, borders, ground shadow, motion blur, speed lines, glow halo, bloom, gradients, anti-aliasing, 1-pixel thin lines, floating particles, extra limbs, a second weapon, cells of different sizes, the character changing size, a 3/4 head or body turn, the body turning to show a step, a swing or the cloth, realistic or painterly style, 3D render, the side view facing right, two eyes in the side view, extra cells, walking or attacking poses.
```

*Đứng yên 3 hướng* → đính kèm `docs/art/topdown/light/miner-views.png`, lưu thành `docs/art/topdown/light/miner-idle.png` (3 hàng × 6 khung: ngang / trước / sau)

```
Pixel art sprite sheet: ONE image, 3 rows x 6 columns (18 equal frames, evenly spaced, nothing touching another frame; frames about 61 x 43 px native per frame), a slow looping IDLE animation of the SAME character as in the attached model sheet. Row 1 = SIDE view facing LEFT, row 2 = FRONT view, row 3 = BACK view; frames go left to right in time order; within a row the feet stand on one ground line at the same spot.

ONE DIRECTION PER ROW (the most important rule)
- Row 1: SIDE view, strict profile facing LEFT in EVERY frame: head, chest, hips and feet all point LEFT; only ONE eye visible at the left edge of the head; the face never turns toward the viewer; never two eyes, the face turning toward the viewer, facing right, a front or back view.
- Row 2: FRONT view, facing the viewer straight on in EVERY frame: both eyes visible, chest and hips square to the viewer, the body left-right symmetrical apart from the held gear, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing down the screen; never a profile, a single eye, the head or body turned sideways, a back view.
- Row 3: BACK view, the back to the viewer in EVERY frame: no eyes, no face and no profile visible, shoulders and hips square, the cloth covering the back, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing up the screen; never any eye or face, a profile, the head or body turned sideways, a front view.
- Every frame of a row is a redraw of that row's model view; between frames only the breathing bob, the cloth, the hair and a slight weapon bob change. Nobody turns, nothing switches to another view, no 3/4 angle.
- Final check before finishing, count the eyes in every frame, the LAST frame of each row included: row 1 = ONE eye in all 6 frames, row 2 = TWO eyes (the face) in all 6 frames, row 3 = NO eyes (the back) in all 6 frames. Fix any frame that breaks this; never let a row end in another view.

CHARACTER (Temple of Light civilization, Light element, gold miner "Miner"), identical in all 18 frames: same colours, gear, size and pixel scale
- Build: chibi stickman with a big round head (about a third of the total height) and a short body, slightly smaller and leaner, about 90% of a normal stickman. Size: about 18 x 18 px footprint, about 32 px tall.
- Head: big spiky glowing golden hair with a bright white four-pointed star in it, bold pixel clusters hugging the head. Black face, no mouth, no nose; slanted glowing golden eyes (2-pixel clusters with a white core pixel): TWO eyes in the front view, only ONE eye at the front edge of the head in the side view, no eyes in the back and top views.
- Body: solid black body with thin glowing golden crack lines on the limbs, a small brown cloth gold sack with a golden drawstring on a strap at the hip, gold nuggets peeking out.
- Cloth: short scarf in rich gold (#e8a91c), ragged stepped pixel edges, hanging close to the body.
- Gear: glowing pickaxe; every glowing part in radiant gold (#ffd84a).
- Pose: tool resting on the shoulder in one hand, relaxed.

GEAR LOCK (check every one of the 18 frames)
- Always drawn, complete, same size and same colours in EVERY frame: glowing pickaxe; a small brown cloth gold sack with a golden drawstring on a strap at the hip.
- The weapon / tool stays in the same hand; when the body hides part of it, the visible ends still show. A frame without the weapon or tool is wrong.

IDLE (6 frames, frame 6 loops back to frame 1; calm and slow, a living stance, not frozen)
- Row 1 (SIDE view, strict profile facing LEFT, copied from cell 2 (SIDE view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):
1. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) exactly the SIDE cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.
2. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf hem 2 px out behind the back (to the right); the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) full inhale: body 1 px up; the cloth billows at its fullest, the hem 3 px out behind the back; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the hem drops to 1 px out, a ripple running down the cloth; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the cloth almost settled, only the hem tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) back to neutral height, the same view as frame 1 of THIS row (not of the row below), so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Row 2 (FRONT view, facing the viewer straight on, copied from cell 3 (FRONT view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):
1. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) exactly the FRONT cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.
2. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf edges 2 px out to BOTH sides, mirrored left and right; the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the cloth edges flare at their fullest, 3 px out on both sides, still behind the body; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the edges drop to 1 px out, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the cloth almost settled, only the hem tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the FRONT view with the face and both eyes like frame 1 of this row (NOT the back view of the row below), so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Row 3 (BACK view, the back to the viewer, copied from cell 4 (BACK view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):
1. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exactly the BACK cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.
2. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf hem 2 px and sways it 2 px to the left; the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the hem at its fullest, lifted 3 px and swayed 3 px to the left; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the hem swings back through the centre, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the hem drifting back to the centre, only its tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the back view like frame 1 of this row, so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Slow-down: the cloth motion eases out like fabric settling after a gentle breeze: big movement in frames 2-3, smaller in frame 4, tiny in frame 5. Hair sways with the cloth, a little behind it.
- Breathing: a clear slow rhythm, inhale (frames 2-3) and exhale (frames 4-5), the shoulders and chest rising and sinking 1 px.
- Weapon / tool: stays in the same hand and the same grip, only bobbing 1 px and tilting 1 px with the breath; never raised, swung or waved; the free hand stays relaxed.
- Element touch, subtle and slow: the hair star twinkles brighter and back, the golden crack lines pulse.

STYLE
- Chunky pixel art: every art pixel a crisp square block, upscaled with nearest neighbour.
- 3-tone shading (cool dark shadow, saturated mid-tone, warm highlight), bold 1px dark outline.
- Arms, legs, weapon shafts and staffs at least 2 px thick.
- Glows are solid bright pixel clusters with a white-hot core; every effect is a solid pixel shape touching the body, the weapon or the ground line, nothing floating.
- Strictly orthographic: no perspective, no 3/4 angle.
- Background: fully transparent PNG (alpha). No white, no colour, no checkerboard pattern.

AVOID: text, labels, numbers, grid lines, borders, ground shadow, motion blur, speed lines, glow halo, bloom, gradients, anti-aliasing, 1-pixel thin lines, floating particles, extra limbs, a second weapon, cells of different sizes, the character changing size, a 3/4 head or body turn, the body turning to show a step, a swing or the cloth, realistic or painterly style, 3D render, walking, attacking, the feet moving, raising a hand, waving, swinging the weapon, the weapon changing hands, a missing weapon or tool, a stiff frozen cloth, a jerky fast cloth, any row with frames in another view.
```

```
- Row 2: FRONT view, facing the viewer straight on in EVERY frame: both eyes visible, chest and hips square to the viewer, the body left-right symmetrical apart from the held gear, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing down the screen; never a profile, a single eye, the head or body turned sideways, a back view.
- Row 3: BACK view, the back to the viewer in EVERY frame: no eyes, no face and no profile visible, shoulders and hips square, the cloth covering the back, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing up the screen; never any eye or face, a profile, the head or body turned sideways, a front view.
```

```
- Row 1: SIDE view, strict profile facing LEFT in EVERY frame: head, chest, hips and feet all point LEFT; only ONE eye visible at the left edge of the head; the face never turns toward the viewer; never two eyes, the face turning toward the viewer, facing right, a front or back view.
- Row 2: FRONT view, facing the viewer straight on in EVERY frame: both eyes visible, chest and hips square to the viewer, the body left-right symmetrical apart from the held gear, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing down the screen; never a profile, a single eye, the head or body turned sideways, a back view.
- Row 3: BACK view, the back to the viewer in EVERY frame: no eyes, no face and no profile visible, shoulders and hips square, the cloth covering the back, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing up the screen; never any eye or face, a profile, the head or body turned sideways, a front view.
- Every frame of a row is a redraw of that row's model view; between frames only the breathing bob, the cloth, the hair and a slight weapon bob change. Nobody turns, nothing switches to another view, no 3/4 angle.
- Final check before finishing, count the eyes in every frame, the LAST frame of each row included: row 1 = ONE eye in all 6 frames, row 2 = TWO eyes (the face) in all 6 frames, row 3 = NO eyes (the back) in all 6 frames. Fix any frame that breaks this; never let a row end in another view.

- Build: chibi stickman with a big round head (about a third of the total height) and a short body. Size: about 20 x 20 px footprint, about 36 px tall.
```
```
- Head: silver-white spiky hair swept back by the wind, bold pixel clusters hugging the head. - Body: dark navy body, white bandage wraps on the forearms, a white waist sash, two small solid pale-cyan wind wings on the back.
```
```
- Cloth: ankle-length robe-cape in sky blue (#2f8fc4), ragged stepped pixel edges, hanging close to the body.
- Gear: glowing staff topped with a small spinning windmill; every glowing part in pale icy cyan (#a8ecff).
- Pose: staff planted on the ground, the other palm open and glowing.
```

```
GEAR LOCK (check every one of the 18 frames)

IDLE (6 frames, frame 6 loops back to frame 1; calm and slow, a living stance, not frozen)
- Row 1 (SIDE view, strict profile facing LEFT, copied from cell 2 (SIDE view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):
1. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) exactly the SIDE cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.

3. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) full inhale: body 1 px up; the cloth billows at its fullest, the hem 3 px out behind the back; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the hem drops to 1 px out, a ripple running down the cloth; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the cloth almost settled, only the hem tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (SIDE view, profile facing left, one eye) back to neutral height, the same view as frame 1 of THIS row (not of the row below), so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Row 2 (FRONT view, facing the viewer straight on, copied from cell 3 (FRONT view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):

2. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf edges 2 px out to BOTH sides, mirrored left and right; the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the cloth edges flare at their fullest, 3 px out on both sides, still behind the body; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the edges drop to 1 px out, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the cloth almost settled, only the hem tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the FRONT view with the face and both eyes like frame 1 of this row (NOT the back view of the row below), so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.

1. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exactly the BACK cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.
2. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf hem 2 px and sways it 2 px to the left; the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the hem at its fullest, lifted 3 px and swayed 3 px to the left; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the hem swings back through the centre, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the hem drifting back to the centre, only its tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the back view like frame 1 of this row, so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Slow-down: the cloth motion eases out like fabric settling after a gentle breeze: big movement in frames 2-3, smaller in frame 4, tiny in frame 5. Hair sways with the cloth, a little behind it.
- Breathing: a clear slow rhythm, inhale (frames 2-3) and exhale (frames 4-5), the shoulders and chest rising and sinking 1 px.
- Weapon / tool: stays in the same hand and the same grip, only bobbing 1 px and tilting 1 px with the breath; never raised, swung or waved; the free hand stays relaxed.
- Element touch, subtle and slow: the wind is strongest here: cape and scarf flap hard, the hair streams back, the small wings flutter.

STYLE
- Chunky pixel art: every art pixel a crisp square block, upscaled with nearest neighbour.
- 3-tone shading (cool dark shadow, saturated mid-tone, warm highlight), bold 1px dark outline.
- Arms, legs, weapon shafts and staffs at least 2 px thick.
- Glows are solid bright pixel clusters with a white-hot core; every effect is a solid pixel shape touching the body, the weapon or the ground line, nothing floating.
- Strictly orthographic: no perspective, no 3/4 angle.
- Background: fully transparent PNG (alpha). No white, no colour, no checkerboard pattern.

AVOID: text, labels, numbers, grid lines, borders, ground shadow, motion blur, speed lines, glow halo, bloom, gradients, anti-aliasing, 1-pixel thin lines, floating particles, extra limbs, a second weapon, cells of different sizes, the character changing size, a 3/4 head or body turn, the body turning to show a step, a swing or the cloth, realistic or painterly style, 3D render, walking, attacking, the feet moving, raising a hand, waving, swinging the weapon, the weapon changing hands, a missing weapon or tool, a stiff frozen cloth, a jerky fast cloth, any row with frames in another view.
```

```
- Row 3: BACK view, the back to the viewer in EVERY frame: no eyes, no face and no profile visible, shoulders and hips square, the cloth covering the back, like a classic 16-bit RPG sprite facing up the screen; never any eye or face, a profile, the head or body turned sideways, a front view.
```

```
- Gear: black silhouette catapult with glowing elemental parts and a glowing element boulder in its cup, one stickman operator; every glowing part in amber (#ffb43a).
- Pose: the machine standing still and loaded, the operator standing behind it at ease.
```

```
IDLE (6 frames, frame 6 loops back to frame 1; calm and slow, a living stance, not frozen)

3. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the cloth edges flare at their fullest, 3 px out on both sides, still behind the body; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the edges drop to 1 px out, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the cloth almost settled, only the hem tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (FRONT view, both eyes, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the FRONT view with the face and both eyes like frame 1 of this row (NOT the back view of the row below), so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Row 3 (BACK view, the back to the viewer, copied from cell 4 (BACK view) of the attached sheet in all 6 frames):
1. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exactly the BACK cell of the attached sheet, the cloth hanging still.
2. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) inhale: body 1 px up; a gentle breeze lifts the cape / scarf hem 2 px and sways it 2 px to the left; the chest expands 1 px, the weapon / tool rises 1 px with the shoulders.
3. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) full inhale: body 1 px up; the hem at its fullest, lifted 3 px and swayed 3 px to the left; chest at its fullest, the weapon / tool tip tilts 1 px back.
4. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) the breeze fades: body back to neutral height; the hem swings back through the centre, a ripple running down; the chest relaxes, the weapon / tool settles back to its rest position.
5. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) exhale: knees bend slightly, body 1 px down; the hem drifting back to the centre, only its tips moving 1 px; the chest sinks 1 px, the weapon / tool dips 1 px with the shoulders.
6. (BACK view, no face, symmetrical) back to neutral height, still the back view like frame 1 of this row, so the loop is seamless; the weapon / tool exactly as in frame 1.
- Slow-down: the cloth motion eases out like fabric settling after a gentle breeze: big movement in frames 2-3, smaller in frame 4, tiny in frame 5. Hair sways with the cloth, a little behind it.
- Breathing: a clear slow rhythm, inhale (frames 2-3) and exhale (frames 4-5), the shoulders and chest rising and sinking 1 px.
- Weapon / tool: stays in the same hand and the same grip, only bobbing 1 px and tilting 1 px with the breath; never raised, swung or waved; the free hand stays relaxed.
```
```
- Element touch, subtle and slow: the amber cracks glow brighter and dimmer like slow magma, the body barely moves (heavy and steady).

STYLE
- Chunky pixel art: every art pixel a crisp square block, upscaled with nearest neighbour.
- 3-tone shading (cool dark shadow, saturated mid-tone, warm highlight), bold 1px dark outline.
- Arms, legs, weapon shafts and staffs at least 2 px thick.
- Glows are solid bright pixel clusters with a white-hot core; every effect is a solid pixel shape touching the body, the weapon or the ground line, nothing floating.
- Strictly orthographic: no perspective, no 3/4 angle.
- Background: fully transparent PNG (alpha). No white, no colour, no checkerboard pattern.
```
